title: Office Battlefield - Command Respect
summary: Jason traces his need to make Jamin afraid back to childhood violence and the fear that stayed with him. David asks him to stop escalating the workplace conflict; Jason recognizes that his own choices repeated the lesson he learned at five.

portal.scene: Jason faces a small boy in an arched mirror while a desk, work ticket, phone, and a note saying Jason, please, surround them.
